title: Phase 1: render --stems, a rendered clash check, and the audition loop
description: 1a apricity render --stems DIR (each track soloed through its groups and sends, pre-master, as 32-bit float, plus stems.json; bit-identical without the flag). 1b analysis/apricity_analyze/check.py and scripts/check-stems.py: per-stem, per-beat chroma weighted by loudness and tonalness; the clash kernel K=[0,1,.35,0,0,.05,.7,0,.05,0,.3,1], with bass m2/M2/M7 doubled; chord clash; a 0-100 objective with energy, density, coverage and tuning guards against a baseline; prose findings, leave-one-out, smear, wrap; --json; renders/log.jsonl. 1c audition.sh --check wired to both. Tests on synthetic stems.
